Levo cuts cloud bills and TCO without cutting corners

All of Levo’s modules run on just 0.5 vCPU and 0.5GB RAM - even in the most demanding production environments.

We process <1% of traffic in our SaaS, saving enterprises $100,000 to $500,000 annually in egress and cloud costs.

We achieve this by sampling only what matters, processing it locally, and discarding traffic after analysis.

No terabytes of duplication. No expensive mirroring. No noisy instrumentation slowing pipelines.

Our flexible config and optimization beat API security modules retrofitted onto edge-based architectures.

Levo was engineered from the ground up to be precision-oriented, not brute-force dependent.

<!-- JSON-LD automation implementation -->
<script>
/**
 * Global JSON-LD injector for Levo.ai
 * - Adds Organization + WebSite schema on every page
 * - Adds BreadcrumbList on deep paths
 * - Adds Article schema on blog posts (by URL prefix)
 * - Adds Service schema on product/feature/use-case pages (by URL prefixes)
 * - Adds FAQPage schema if FAQ blocks are detected
 * - Normalizes `sameAs` URLs (Twitter/X status -> profile, LinkedIn company root, GitHub org/user root)
 *
 * Place once in: Webflow → Site settings → Custom Code → Head
 * Notes:
 * - This uses client-side JS. It will not appear in "view-source" but will show up in the DOM and in Rich Results Test.
 * - Do not duplicate server-rendered JSON-LD types. The script checks and skips if a type already exists.
 * - You can force the page type with: window.LEVO_PAGE_TYPE = 'article' | 'service' | 'webpage' | 'none'
 */
(function () {
  // -----------------------------
  // CONFIG: edit these as needed
  // -----------------------------
  var SITE = {
    // Public org name in schema
    name: "Levo.ai",

    // Canonical site root (edit if you change domains)
    url: "https://www.levo.ai",

    // Square 512x512 logo used in Organization and as Article publisher logo
    logo512: "https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68a0867885b861909cb86944/68b99042fdca732433aacf75_logo-512.png",

    // Public profiles for Organization.sameAs (will be normalized below)
    sameAs: [
      "https://www.linkedin.com/company/levo-inc/",
      "https://twitter.com/LevoIncHQ/status/1924518451445420037",
      "https://github.com/levoai"
    ],

    // Blog post base path. If your posts live at /blog/* change this to "/blog"
    blogPrefix: "/post",

    // URL prefixes that should be marked up as Service pages
    // Add/remove to match your IA
    servicePrefixes: [
      "/use-case", "/use-cases", "/usecase", "/usecases",
      "/vertical", "/verticals",
      "/user-story", "/user-stories",
      "/case-study", "/case-studies", "/casestudy",
      "/product", "/products",
      "/feature", "/features",
      "/solutions", "/solution",
      "/platform"
    ]
  };

  // -----------------------------
  // Helper utilities
  // -----------------------------

  // Absolutize a URL relative to current origin
  function abs(u){
    try {
      if (!u) return "";
      return new URL(u, location.origin).href;
    } catch(e){
      return "";
    }
  }

  // Get trimmed textContent for a selector, else empty string
  function text(sel){
    var el = document.querySelector(sel);
    return el ? el.textContent.trim() : "";
  }

  // Get <meta name="..."> content
  function meta(name){
    var el = document.querySelector('meta[name="'+name+'"]');
    return el ? el.content : "";
  }

  // Get <meta property="..."> content (for og:*, article:*, twitter:*)
  function metaProp(p){
    var el = document.querySelector('meta[property="'+p+'"]');
    return el ? el.content : "";
  }

  // Check if a JSON-LD script with a given @type already exists on the page
  // Prevents duplicates when some types are server-rendered by templates
  function hasLDType(t){
    var s = document.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]');
    for (var i=0; i<s.length; i++){
      try {
        var j = JSON.parse(s[i].textContent);
        var arr = Array.isArray(j) ? j : [j];
        for (var k=0; k<arr.length; k++){
          var types = [].concat(arr[k]["@type"] || []);
          if (types.includes(t)) return true;
        }
      } catch(e){
        // Ignore JSON parse errors to avoid blocking the rest
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  // Append a JSON-LD object to <head>
  function addLD(obj){
    if (!obj) return;
    var s = document.createElement('script');
    s.type = "application/ld+json";
    // No pretty-print to keep payload small
    s.text = JSON.stringify(obj);
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  // Turn "use-case" into "Use Case" for breadcrumbs
  function titleCase(slug){
    return decodeURIComponent(slug)
      .replace(/[-_]+/g, " ")
      .replace(/\b\w/g, function(c){ return c.toUpperCase() });
  }

  // Split path into non-empty segments
  function parts(){
    return location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  }

  // True if current path is exactly the prefix or starts with prefix + "/"
  function isPrefix(p){
    return location.pathname === p || location.pathname.startsWith(p + "/");
  }

  // Page classification by path
  function isArticle(){ return isPrefix(SITE.blogPrefix) }
  function isService(){ return SITE.servicePrefixes.some(function(p){ return isPrefix(p) }) }

  /**
   * Normalize Organization.sameAs URLs:
   * - Twitter/X: convert any /status/<id> to profile root /<handle>
   * - LinkedIn company: force /company/<slug>/ with trailing slash
   * - GitHub: collapse /<owner>/<repo> and /orgs/<org> to /<owner|org>
   * - Strip query strings and fragments
   */
  function normalizeSameAs(list){
    return (list || []).map(function(u){
      try {
        var url = new URL(u);
        url.hash = "";
        url.search = "";
        var host = url.hostname.replace(/^www\./,'').toLowerCase();
        var path = url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/,''); // trim trailing slash for logic
        var segs;

        // x.com → twitter.com
        if (host === "x.com") host = "twitter.com";

        // Twitter/X: reduce to profile root /<handle>
        if (host === "twitter.com") {
          segs = path.split("/").filter(Boolean); // /handle[/status/....]
          if (segs.length >= 2 && segs[1] === "status") {
            path = "/" + segs[0];
          } else if (segs.length >= 1) {
            path = "/" + segs[0];
          } else {
            path = "";
          }
        }

        // LinkedIn: force /company/<slug>/
        if (host === "linkedin.com") {
          segs = path.split("/").filter(Boolean);
          var idx = segs.indexOf("company");
          if (idx !== -1 && segs[idx+1]) {
            path = "/company/" + segs[idx+1];
          } else if (segs[0] === "company" && segs[1]) {
            path = "/company/" + segs[1];
          }
          if (/^\/company\/[^\/]+$/.test(path)) path += "/";
        }

        // GitHub: collapse repo/orgs to owner root
        if (host === "github.com") {
          segs = path.split("/").filter(Boolean);
          if (segs[0] === "orgs" && segs[1]) {
            path = "/" + segs[1]; // /orgs/<org> -> /<org>
          } else if (segs.length >= 1) {
            path = "/" + segs[0]; // /<owner>/<repo> -> /<owner>
          } else {
            path = "";
          }
        }

        return "https://" + host + path;
      } catch(e){
        // If URL constructor fails, return original string
        return u;
      }
    });
  }

  // -----------------------------------
  // 1) Organization + WebSite (global)
  // -----------------------------------
  if (!hasLDType("Organization")) {
    addLD({
      "@context":"https://schema.org",
      "@type":"Organization",
      "name": SITE.name,

  // - On blog posts, wrap FAQs in an element with class ".blog-faq-block"

        // Pattern 1: explicit item structure

class="arch_card"><p class="arch_card-text">No terabytes of duplication. No expensive mirroring. No noisy instrumentation slowing pipelines.</p><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d0ca01084046ac052b0d8d/68d0ca01084046ac052b0e77_card-4.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="arch_card-img"></div><div class="arch_card"><p class="arch_card-text">Our flexible config and optimization beat API security modules retrofitted onto edge-based architectures.</p><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d0ca01084046ac052b0d8d/68d0ca01084046ac052b0eb5_card%205.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="arch_card-img"></div><div class="arch_card"><p class="arch_card-text">Levo was engineered from the ground up to be precision-oriented, not brute-force dependent.</p><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d0ca01084046ac052b0d8d/68d0ca01084046ac052b0e70_card%206.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="arch_card-img"></div></div><div class="arch_grid-bg-gradient-wrapper"><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d0ca01084046ac052b0d8d/68d0ca01084046ac052b0e10_why-grid-bg.svg" loading="lazy" alt="" class="arch_grid-bg-gradient"></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="section_comp"><div class="padding-global padding-section-medium"><div class="container-large"><div class="comp_component"><div><h2 class="comp_heading">Everyone else secures APIs in parts <br>Levo secures the whole SDLC</h2></div><div aria-label="comparision table comparing levo with it's competitors" class="comp_table"><div class="comp_col-1"><div class="comp_table-title"><div>Features / Capabilities</div></div><div el="comp-field" data-wf--comp-table---field--variant="base" class="comp_table-field"><div role="img" el="Yes" aria-label="Tick Symbol" class="comp_table-icon w-embed"><svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 25 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
